string-array.name: changelog_v0_0_47
string-array.item: Fixed: the WiFi listener could resolve a VPN\'s tunnel address instead of the real LAN IP when a VPN ran alongside WiFi — now fails closed instead, with a clear \"VPN active\" message.
Fixed inconsistent label font size in Settings > General.
Performance overlay now defaults to the bottom-right corner.

string-array.name: changelog_v0_0_46
string-array.item: Dark theme refinements: near-black slate background instead of pure black, plus a proper error color token.
Fixed a WCAG AA contrast failure on the landing page\'s \"Download APK\" button in light mode.
Settings screen and splash screen now actually use the new slate palette.

string-array.name: changelog_v0_0_45
string-array.item: Rebrand: new app icon, logo and banner across the app and the landing page.
Fixed the launcher icon getting clipped by circular launcher masks (e.g. Samsung One UI).
CI hardened: workflow triggers scoped by path, GitHub Actions pinned to a commit SHA.

string-array.name: changelog_v0_0_44
string-array.item: App launcher icon redesigned with the official Apple and Android marks.

string-array.name: changelog_v0_0_43
string-array.item: Settings screen rebuilt as a full-screen, traditional Android layout with tabs.
Fixed delayed typing and cursor updates on a mostly static extended display.

string-array.name: changelog_v0_0_42
string-array.item: Settings and About dialogs get a translucent, frosted-glass-style container.
Fixed the header overlapping the theme/language switcher on medium-width screens.
Landing page rewritten in React + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui.

string-array.name: changelog_v0_0_41
string-array.item: Fixed translation errors in the Code of Conduct/Contributing pages.

string-array.name: changelog_v0_0_40
string-array.item: Protocol parity with the latest Mac sender: decode-ceiling negotiation, UDP cursor side channel, real stylus pressure and tilt.
Korean translation added.

string-array.name: changelog_v0_0_39
string-array.item: Korean landing page.

string-array.name: changelog_v0_0_38
string-array.item: Simplified Chinese and Japanese added to the app.
Landing page becomes multilingual, with its own page per language.

string-array.name: changelog_v0_0_37
string-array.item: Fixed mDNS not re-announcing after a WiFi IP change.
Fixed a MediaCodec reconfigure throttle edge case that could leave the decoder misconfigured.
Security hardening: bounded cursor hotspot values, sanitized control-message logging.
